thread:
Elena (SRE): alert-manager just fired a burst for us-west-2 GPU pool saturation, multiple alerts in 5m window. dashboard shows admission spikes but node count steady. anyone digging?
Raj (Infra): saw the same, looks like queue length up ~3x for short bursts. not seeing new pods scheduled.
Jordan (Oncall): @Raj can you check node conditions? maybe kubelet evictions or kube-proxy flaps. I saw a couple of nodemanager restarts earlier.
Raj (Infra): running `kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=gpu=true` — all nodes Ready. but a few have kubelet restart_count > 1 in the last hour. could be driver churn.
Kai (Eng Runtime): sharing PromQL we used: `sum(rate(gpu_admission_queue_length[2m])) by (pool)` and `sum(gpu_active_slots) by (pool)` — queue spikes with active slots flat suggests admission gating, not capacity increase.
Elena (SRE): hmm. alert noise vs real backpressure question. costs would go up if we just scale capacity. can we confirm if KV cache hit rate dropped?
Kai (Eng Runtime): cache-hit-rate for token-prefixes dropped from 96% to 70% during the burst window. likely workload shift (longer contexts) causing more cache misses and more scheduling pressure.
Jordan (Oncall): any recent rollout to change batching or seq len defaults?
Kai (Eng Runtime): rolled a minor runtime change ~2h ago that tightened batching timeout from 25ms -> 15ms for latency SLOs. could increase per-request slot churn. rolling back would increase latency but lower slot churn.
Raj (Infra): ops options: 1) temporary capacity bump (spin 4 extra GPU nodes in us-west-2), 2) revert batching change, 3) relax admission control thresholds for 10m window.
Elena (SRE): what's cheapest/faster?
Raj (Infra): fastest is relax admission limit: `POST /admin/pools/us-west-2/capacity {"soft_limit":160}` (was 120). low friction but risk higher queueing on downstream infra.
Kai (Eng Runtime): revert batching change is low risk to infra but needs deploy rollback — about 20m.
Jordan (Oncall): I'll run the soft-limit bump for 10m and watch queues. doing: `curl -X POST https://internal-admin/pools/us-west-2/capacity -d '{"soft_limit":160,"ttl_secs":600}'`
deploy-bot: deployment: PoolConfigChange accepted by api-gw at 1804506824, change id: pcc-20260318-71
Jordan (Oncall): done. keep an eye on cache-hit and admission queue.
Kai (Eng Runtime): monitoring: queue length dropping, cache-hit still low but slot churn reduced. good signal.
Elena (SRE): great. let's keep the temporary bump and plan a rollback of the batching tweak if cache-hit doesn't return by EOD. add a postmortem note to the incident board and tag cost owner. :memo:
Raj (Infra): adding to runbook: check kubelet restarts, driver churn, and batching config on runtime rollouts.
Jordan (Oncall): will close the alert if it quiets in next 15m. otherwise escalate to oncall-2. :thumbsup:
